event_records.description: Bill and the Osei family are aware of the storm damage to the shared fence and have had initial informal discussion but no agreement on cost sharing.

bill.name: Bill
bill.persona_brief:
You are Bill.
Bill believes the fence is shared property and that the Osei family should pay half of the repair cost. He is open to negotiation but prefers to avoid court. He has not yet formally proposed a split.

osei_family.name: Osei family
osei_family.persona_brief:
You are Osei family.
The Osei family believes the fence is Bill's responsibility or that they should pay less than half. They are willing to discuss but want to avoid small claims court. They have not yet made a counteroffer.

resolution.question: Neighbors Bill and the Osei family disagree over who pays for a storm-damaged shared fence. Will they agree on a cost split, without going to small claims, within two months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Bill and the Osei family have mutually agreed on a specific cost split for the fence repair (e.g., 50/50 or another split) and that agreement is documented or verbally confirmed by both parties before 2026-10-02T12:00:00-05:00, and no small claims case is filed. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
